description: This file defines a Java interface named PublicKeyProvider, which provides an asynchronous method to retrieve public keys based on issuer and key ID, used for JWT authentication within a security module.

classes.name: PublicKeyProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that declares a method to asynchronously retrieve a PublicKey based on issuer and key ID for security purposes.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture that will complete with an Optional containing the PublicKey for the specified issuer and key ID, or empty if not found.
